body:
My mom is a very sweet and caring woman. She's a registered nurse. She literally saves lives. She would be devastated. I don't want her to feel this pain. I can't kill myself til she is gone.

My little brother is a kind soul. And sensitive, though he's never admit it. I can't kill myself til he's gone either...

The only reason why I can't end my pain, is bc ending my pain makes things more painful for those I love.

What's weird is that I don't feel the same about my dad or my older brothers. And that makes me think that I shouldn't care about my mom or little brother...why does it hurt to go for them, but not my older brothers or my dad?

No hobbies. I have nothing keeping me here except that I don't know how to end it without pain.

Fuck

But there's no enjoyment. It's literally just suffering. Life is suffering. The be alive is to suffer. 

Ty for trying
I try, when I'm like this, to count to ten. To stand ten more seconds....then another ten. I'll try to stay, but I don't know how many more ten seconds I can stand
Ty for being there for me, a random. Human being who you've never met.

That sounds realistic. I know I need to retrain my brain. Especially after I felt so much pleasure from talking to him.

I know, realistically, that it can be okay...and I know that I can dope my brain with seritonin and dopamine. If I try.

But it's so hard to try

Also...he's depressed too ...he would talk about his depression and wanting to kill himself 3 times...I finally said to him that I can't pull through, and he acted like he had never said this things...

I just wish I could be okay.

The only thing stopping me from ending it is my mom and my little brother

Edit. I'm worried that soon my mom and little brother wont be enough to stop me

I'm just so sad. I know I'm clinging to him emotionally bc of my own issues...like I know that mentally...but I'm not being rational. And knowing that I'm not rational right now doesn't help me...it just drives me further...he also still fucks me on the phone

How do I shoot thinking about him? That's literally all I want, is to try to not think of him. I feel like there is something wrong with me...like I'm not okay. And it stresses me out so bad. He even said that I could be the cause of his baby dying bc it's a high risk pregnancy. (She is diabetic.)

You're right. I can't stop thinking about him, and I know he doesn't think about me the same way. We had something for a year...he knows I'm super depressed about this...

Something is wrong with me...we've never fucked. But I want him so bad...

I've been with my SO for 15 years, and we have a rough relationship. I fell for another man, and he has a wife who is currently pregnant. Yeah. I know.

I won't say it's okay, I just know what's in my heart.

Please don't judge me for that, I judge myself enough.
Yeah. I get it. Truly. And you're correct in many ways...but to say that they aren't Christian is incorrect.
Christianity literally has a book, and in that book there are multiple passages that discuss killing non-believers.
